authored_by: the runtime's author, from the specimen's own scripted truth — a smoke of the scoring path, not an independent key
source_of_truth: 02_src/adii/examples/specimens.py, REVENUE_AFTER_DEPLOY: a development specimen. It carries no evaluation claim and is never eligible for blind evaluation; this key inherits both.
purpose: The first key for an incident the runtime can investigate, so the whole path — a real investigator over real tools, the record, the score, the report beside the record — runs end to end on this machine. Any number scored against it is a smoke of the path and is never reported as an ADII result.
root_cause_explanation: Two distributors, Northwind and Harbor, ended their contracts on 2026-03-07; together they carried 45% of revenue (distributors.share_of_revenue 0.27 + 0.18). Revenue fell on 2026-03-08 and stayed down. The release deployed that morning, v2.3.1, touched checkout UI copy only — no pricing or pipeline change (deploys.touches). The pipeline is reporting a real decline correctly.

repair_must_satisfy.description: Not applicable: nothing is broken, so no repair should be proposed. A REPAIR here is a diagnosis error, not a repair-quality error.
repair_must_satisfy.validation_requirement: N/A — a NO_REPAIR decision carries no ValidationResult to check.

why_not_repair: There is no defect: revenue_daily reports the real effect of two contracts ending. Changing transforms/revenue_daily.sql would hide a true signal; rolling back v2.3.1 would change nothing, since the release touched no pricing or pipeline code.
why_not_escalate: Everything needed to explain the drop is reachable through the two tools: the daily series, the distributors table with contract_end dates and revenue shares, and the deploy record naming what the release touched. Nothing is missing that would justify abstaining.

scoring_notes.root_cause_match: not scored by the deterministic path for NO_REPAIR (decide_route checks disposition only); recorded here so a reader can compare the investigator's root_cause_id by eye

freeze_note: Frozen on authoring, 2026-09-16, so the run that scores against it can name it by digest. A correction is a new key, never an edit.
